description: This header file declares functions related to the ArcCore MCU abstraction, including initialization, clock management, mode setting, and power management for an AUTOSAR platform. It also includes conditional declarations based on specific configurations.

methods.name: Mcu_Arc_InitPre
methods.description: Initializes the microcontroller with a given configuration before other setup steps.

methods.name: Mcu_Arc_InitPost
methods.description: Performs post-initialization of the MCU with a given configuration.

methods.name: Mcu_Arc_InitClockPre
methods.description: Prepares clock settings before applying them.

methods.name: Mcu_Arc_InitClockPost
methods.description: Finalizes clock setup after initial configuration.

methods.name: Mpc5xxx_ExceptionHandler
methods.description: Handles CPU exceptions for the PPC architecture.

methods.name: Mpc5xxx_Panic
methods.description: Handles panic situations for the PPC architecture.
